prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE NEW contemporary corporate logo SYMBOL for 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO, company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司. The client rejected previous marks as too HARD in both COLOR and GEOMETRY. This is a genuine redesign of form and color, not a rigid mark with pastel recoloring. Primary feeling: soft, humane, airy, flowing, confident professional calm. Use curved transitions, lighter mass, moderate chroma, harmonious warm/cool midtones. Keep name-source 礼林 and values 善心善念善行; engineering and software live subtly in SHARED SUPPORT and CONNECTED PATHS. No collage of industry icons. Construction: A CALM ASYMMETRIC SOFT-JOIN emblem: TWO gently wrapping curved modules embrace ONE large continuous WHITE CHANNEL, sharing a short smooth saddle connection. Broad rounded ends, no literal water drop, heart outline, infinity knot, ring, square enclosure or separate leaf. No more than THREE substantial curved pieces; lighter mass than white openings, balanced open silhouette, no glossy surfaces. Suggest practical collaboration/engineering via actual support and software via the clear continuous passage, without explicit industry pictograms. Palette: Smoky teal #729A9B, soft plum #A48BA8 and a small warm blush #D6ACA5; subtle within-piece gradients with no lighting effect. ONE centered standalone emblem on pure WHITE, ample margin. NO company lettering or captions: a neutral wordmark will be consistently added separately. Flat vector-like polished graphic, smooth contours, very restrained 2D gradients permitted, NO 3D, glass, glow, bevels, texture or shadows. NO high-saturation royal blue, bright red, neon lime, red-yellow-blue hard clash, sharp polygon tips, squared I-beams, blocky modules, exposed chips or gears. Do not wash the mark out into nearly invisible pastel, and do not imitate an established brand.
